title: Petal Swap
description: A cheerful garden match-3: swap flowers to make rows of three, chain cascades and set off bees, sunbursts and rainbow seeds in 30 moves.
how_to: Swipe a flower toward a neighbour to swap them.
Line up 3 or more of the same flower to clear them.
Match 4 for a Bee, an L or T for a Sunburst, 5 for a Rainbow seed.
You have 30 moves. Big scores earn bonus moves!
